# Specs and plans

- Specs: `docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<issue>-<slug>-design.md`, structured with the `pbi-spec` template (`.github/skills/pbi-spec/templates/report-spec.md`).
- Plans: `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<issue>-<slug>.md`, structured by Superpowers `writing-plans` plus the `pbi-plan` addendum (test-first DAX tasks, exact file paths, verification commands).
- The first lines name the GitHub issue (`**Issue:** #12`) and, for plans, the spec (`**Spec:** docs/superpowers/specs/...`).
- Specs record decisions and open questions; plans record tasks. Neither contains secrets, IDs or personal data.
- A changed scope after approval means a new revision section and a new human approval.
